definitions.explanation: A school club whose members write poetry, short fiction, essays, and similar literary work and typically publish a club magazine.

examples.japanese: {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write poetry in the literature club.

examples.japanese: {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部誌|ぶし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}→短編小説：20776_tanpenshousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}して→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a short story published in the literature club's magazine.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{文芸|ぶんげい}→文芸：12990_bungei⟧ (literary arts) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club). Common at middle schools, high schools, and universities; usually quieter and less athletic in image than sports clubs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}{員|いん}: literature-club member
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{部誌|ぶし}: literature club's magazine
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: literature-club activities

- {演劇部|えんげきぶ}: drama club — performance-oriented
